scope: Retrospective offline development: 26 previously inspected tasks; no untouched confirmation/test split claimed.

benchmark.population_rule: Reuse all frozen jobs, including Petfinder and small pools; full source coverage required within each admitted pool. Record pool-count and size coverage, without selecting tasks by performance.
benchmark.evaluation: Task-macro pool-normalized selection regret; uniform choice within final tied set. Failures receive regret penalty 1/hit 0 in planned denominator, with coverage and valid-only results separately reported.
benchmark.zero_range_pool: Regret 0 for a valid selection when all candidate utilities are equal.
benchmark.confidence_semantics: Model-reported confidence, not a statistical confidence interval; accepted at >=0.7 under C0 response validation.

policy.aggregation: Frozen clean-ranking-v1 top_set: maximum valid win fraction, then valid unique degree, then retain ties. Allocation/early-stop are the editable module in this environment version.
policy.repeat_query: Return cached same feedback; no additional independent evidence; unique budget unchanged, attempts and cache reads increase.
policy.exhausted_budget: Host automatically finishes using the fixed aggregator.

comparison_allocation.stage: v1 contract; acceptance status in research/state.json

pairwise_judge.contract: Existing author predictions; fresh stochastic/live comparisons require a separate environment version.

candidate_execution.stage: C0 component smoke verified; live deployment pending

online_agent.remaining: Generated validation-prediction contract, whole-script OS isolation, live endpoints and matched resource budgets.

ai_scientist.stage: common CLI contract; autonomous runner integration pending
ai_scientist.remaining: Pin framework version, isolate coder workspace, enforce external aggregate budget and run a separate adapter preflight.
